name: qa-demo-api-testing
description: Newman/Postman API automation test suite for the QA-Demo application (https://qademo.com/). Executes the QA-Demo Project Postman collection (positive/negative/boundary tests plus Phase 5 data-chaining workflows) from the command line.

scripts.test: npm run test:main && npm run test:workflow-auth && npm run test:workflow-cart && npm run test:workflow-products && npm run test:workflow-admin
scripts.test:main: newman run "postman/collections/QA-Demo Project.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/QA-Demo Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "01 - Authentication" --folder "02 - Products" --folder "03 - Cart" --folder "04 - Orders" --folder "05 - Admin" --folder "06 - Images" --folder "07 - Negative Tests" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-main-report.html
scripts.test:workflows: npm run test:workflow-auth && npm run test:workflow-cart && npm run test:workflow-products && npm run test:workflow-admin
scripts.test:workflow-auth: newman run "postman/collections/QA-Demo Project.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/QA-Demo Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "Workflow 01 - Authentication Chaining" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-workflow-01-authentication-report.html
scripts.test:workflow-cart: newman run "postman/collections/QA-Demo Project.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/QA-Demo Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "Workflow 02 - Cart CRUD Lifecycle" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-workflow-02-cart-report.html
scripts.test:workflow-products: newman run "postman/collections/QA-Demo Project.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/QA-Demo Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "Workflow 03 - Products List to Detail" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-workflow-03-products-report.html
scripts.test:workflow-admin: newman run "postman/collections/QA-Demo Project.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/QA-Demo Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "Workflow 04 - Admin Product Stock Update (Requires Authentication)" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-workflow-04-admin-report.html
scripts.test:cli: newman run "postman/collections/QA-Demo Project.postman_collection.json" -e "postman/environments/QA-Demo Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "01 - Authentication" --folder "02 - Products" --folder "03 - Cart" --folder "04 - Orders" --folder "05 - Admin" --folder "06 - Images" --folder "07 - Negative Tests"
